scope: Exact portable CPU reference for the pinned Parakeet audio-to-mel frontend; not installed-runtime qualification

excluded_duplicate.reason: Unreferenced older evidence sibling of 830aa8ac; both have parent 18248be2, and 830aa8ac adds the later recovery evidence used by 0db8584f. It contains no frontend source.

reference.macos_environment: Apple M1 Ultra (Mac13,2), macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), Core ML 3520.5.1, cpuAndNeuralEngine

consumer_contract.input: One non-empty float32 waveform at 16 kHz, no longer than 480000 samples
consumer_contract.output: float32 mel [3001,128] and all-one int32 mask [3001]
consumer_contract.encoder_slice: first 3000 rows, exact against encoder_input_features.npy and encoder_input_mask.npy
consumer_contract.failure_contract: Empty or multi-chunk input and non-400 Hann lengths raise ValueError; no approximate Hann or FFT fallback exists

red_evidence.result: exit 1 before integration: Hann 243/400 mismatches; DFT real 225133/771257 and DFT imag 222670/771257 mismatches. Other captured stages were exact.

verification.result: exit 0; manifest and golden gate passed; preemphasis 480000, Hann 400, filterbank 32896, frames 1536512, DFT real 771257, DFT imag 771257, power 771257, mel projection 384128, logmel 384128, mean 128, and std 128 values all byte-identical
exit 0; 384128/384128 mel values bit-identical, zero maximum and mean absolute difference; shape, masks, encoder slice, and silence tail exact

qualification_boundary.reference_algorithm: qualified for exact comparison against the pinned fixture
qualification_boundary.reason: The oracle performs NumPy tensor work on CPU. It does not execute through Vulkan or ANE and produces no backend trace, so it does not satisfy plan section 3.3 or the zero-CPU-tensor-dispatch gate.
qualification_boundary.encoder_and_full_plan: not claimed; Linux H13 compile, physical runtime execution, encoder numerical parity, local decoder/joint, TDT output, stability, and packaging remain separate gates
